subject: Life Skills
title: The Weekly Review
description: Learn The Weekly Review in one minute.

hook.text: David Allen, creator of GTD, calls the weekly review the single habit that keeps everything else from collapsing.

buildup.text: Without a review, tasks pile up in your head. Your brain loops on them at 2 AM instead of sleeping.

discovery.text: Spend 30 minutes each Friday reviewing what happened, what got missed, and what matters most next week.

twist.text: The review is not planning next week. It is closing this week. Unprocessed loops are what cause mental exhaustion.

climax.text: Three questions are enough: What went well? What stalled? What must happen next week no matter what?

punchline.text: Close the week, or it follows you home.

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of a weekly review?
options: Planning every detail of next week in advance
Closing open loops so your brain stops cycling on unfinished tasks
Tracking how many hours you worked
